title: Fuel injector flow: on target?
intro: A fuel injector is built to deliver **250 mL/min**. From years of records, the flow of single injectors has standard deviation **σ = 6 mL/min**. A quality engineer bench-tests **n = 16** injectors from a new batch and finds a mean flow of **x̄ = 253.3 mL/min**. Is the batch off target, or is 3.3 mL/min above target just chance?
